title: Complaining and solving problems
intro: Things go wrong: laptops crash, orders arrive late, people make mistakes. Learn to describe a problem precisely, complain without sounding rude, apologise properly and agree on a fix.
introBn: সমস্যা স্পষ্টভাবে বলা, ভদ্রভাবে অভিযোগ করা, আন্তরিকভাবে ক্ষমা চাওয়া আর সমাধান প্রস্তাব করার ইংরেজি শিখুন।

units.title: Describing a problem and complaining
units.idea: Describe the problem clearly with patterns like it keeps -ing, it won't start, there seems to be. Then complain politely: focus on the facts and ask for action.
units.ideaBn: সমস্যা স্পষ্টভাবে বলুন: it keeps -ing, it won't…, there seems to be…। অভিযোগে দোষারোপ নয়, তথ্য দিন আর সমাধান চান।

formula.name: Describe
formula.pos: My laptop keeps freezing. · The AC won't turn on. · There seems to be a mistake on the invoice.

formula.name: Complain
formula.pos: I'm afraid I have a problem with… · I'd like to make a complaint about… · I was told… but…

uses.rule: Keep + -ing: something happens again and again (annoying).
uses.ex: The Wi-Fi keeps dropping during calls.

uses.rule: Won't + verb: a machine or person refuses to work.
uses.ex: The printer won't print in colour.

uses.rule: There seems to be…: a soft way to report a problem.
uses.bn: নরমভাবে সমস্যা জানাতে there seems to be।
uses.ex: There seems to be a problem with my salary slip.

uses.rule: Give facts: what, when, what you expected.
uses.bn: কী, কবে, কী আশা করেছিলেন তা বলুন।
uses.ex: I ordered it on 3 May, but it still hasn't arrived.
Could you send a replacement, please?

traps.wrong: My phone is not working since yesterday.
traps.right: My phone hasn't been working since yesterday.

traps.wrong: Your service is very bad, you people never help.
traps.right: I'm afraid I've had a problem with your service. Could you help me sort it out?
traps.why: Attacks the people, not the problem.
traps.bn: মানুষকে দোষ না দিয়ে সমস্যার কথা বলুন।

drills.q: The projector stops every few minutes.

drills.s: There ___ to be a mistake on the bill.

drills.q: Pick the best complaint email opening.
o: I am very angry. Fix this now.
I'm writing about order #4521, which still hasn't arrived after two weeks.
drills.a: I'm writing about order #4521, which still hasn't arrived after two weeks.

o: The internet is again and again going.
The internet is going and going.

drills.s: Could you ___ into it and let me know?

drills.q: দুঃখিত, কিন্তু আমি ভুল সাইজ পেয়েছি।
o: I'm afraid I've received the wrong size.
Sorry but I got wrong size.
I'm afraid you sent me wrong size, you people.
Sorry, I have been received the wrong size.
drills.a: I'm afraid I've received the wrong size.

units.title: Apologising and solving
units.idea: Apologise sincerely and take responsibility, then propose a solution. Use should have and could have to talk about what went wrong in the past.
units.ideaBn: আন্তরিকভাবে ক্ষমা চান, দায় নিন, তারপর সমাধান দিন। অতীতের ভুল নিয়ে বলতে should have / could have।

formula.name: Apologise
formula.pos: I'm really sorry about… · I apologise for the delay. · That's completely our fault.

formula.name: Solve
formula.pos: What we can do is… · Why don't we…? · I'll make sure it doesn't happen again.

formula.name: Past
formula.pos: We should have checked. · You could have told me.

uses.bn: apologise for এর পরে noun বা -ing।
uses.ex: We apologise for the delay in replying.

uses.rule: Offer a concrete solution and time.
uses.ex: I'll send a replacement today, and it should reach you by Thursday.

uses.rule: Should have + past participle: the right action that didn't happen.
uses.bn: যা করা উচিত ছিল কিন্তু হয়নি: should have + V3।
uses.ex: I should have double-checked the figures.

uses.rule: Could have + past participle: a possible action, often a soft criticism.
uses.bn: করা যেত: could have + V3; নরম সমালোচনা।
uses.ex: You could have called me. I'd have helped.

uses.rule: Suggest with Why don't we…? or How about + -ing?
uses.bn: প্রস্তাবে Why don't we…? বা How about + -ing।
uses.ex: How about extending the deadline by two days?

traps.why: Use the past participle after have.

traps.wrong: Sorry for the inconvenience caused to you.
traps.right: I'm so sorry for the trouble this has caused.

traps.wrong: We will apologise for the delay.
traps.why: Apologise now, not in the future.

drills.s: I'm really sorry. That's completely ___ fault.
I should have ___ the client before sending it.

drills.q: Pick the best reply to an angry customer.
o: I'm so sorry about this. I'll arrange a refund today and email you the confirmation.
drills.a: I'm so sorry about this. I'll arrange a refund today and email you the confirmation.

drills.s: Why ___ we split the work between the two teams?

o: You could have told me earlier.
You can have told me earlier.
drills.a: You could have told me earlier.

drills.s: We apologise ___ any confusion this may have caused.
How about ___ the meeting online instead?

o: We should have test the app before launch.
We should had tested the app before launch.
We should have tested the app before launch.
We should tested the app before launch.
drills.a: We should have tested the app before launch.

drills.q: আমি নিশ্চিত করব যেন এটা আর না ঘটে।
o: I'll make sure it doesn't happen again.
I'll make sure it won't happen again never.
I will sure that it not happen again.
I'll make sure it isn't happen again.
drills.a: I'll make sure it doesn't happen again.

mastery.s: The app keeps ___ when I open the camera.
We could have ___ more time if we'd planned better.

mastery.q: Pick the most natural apology to a client.
o: Sorry for the inconvenience caused to you.
I'm really sorry for the delay. Your order will go out first thing tomorrow.
mastery.a: I'm really sorry for the delay. Your order will go out first thing tomorrow.

mastery.q: মনে হচ্ছে আমার অ্যাকাউন্টে কোনো সমস্যা আছে।
o: There seems to be a problem with my account.
It seems there is problem in my account.
There seem to be a problem with my account.
Seems a problem is my account.
mastery.a: There seems to be a problem with my account.

mastery.s: The door ___ open. Can you call security?
The lift ___ out of order since last week.
